# GitHub Actions workflow counters (.github/workflows/*.yml and composite actions), for a rule with
# the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks
# comments, the entries of a matrix's include and exclude lists (the lines below the key that are
# deeper than it, or a list at its depth) and of an inputs: or outputs: mapping (a reusable
# workflow's, a workflow_dispatch's, a job's or an action's: the lines below the key that are deeper
# than it), so an input named runs-on or a job output named matrix is no runner nor matrix (a secret
# an output names is not counted: GitHub does not pass such an output on), not a block scalar: a run:
# block holds the commands and the secrets a job reads. "cron schedules" counts a cron entry of a
# schedule list, in block or flow style (schedule: [{cron: "0 3 * * *"}]). "steps (approx)" counts a
# list entry that starts with a step key, so a "- name:" of a matrix entry does not count; "actions used" an owner/repo@ref or a path in one, not
# a reusable workflow (owner/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref), which "reusable workflow calls"
# counts; "secret references" every secrets.NAME and secrets['NAME'] inside a ${{ }} expression on
# its line (${{ inputs.t || secrets.T }}, two in one expression count twice), the name of a secret,
# never its value; an expression longer than 300 characters before the secret, or with a } in it, is
# not seen. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] comments, matrix include and exclude entries, inputs and outputs
jobs on a runner
reusable workflow calls
steps (approx)
actions used
secret references
cron schedules
matrices
permissions blocks
